messages:
Ana P.: Quick heads-up — NovaModels signaled green on the basic hosting terms but want a carve-out: SIs can redistribute quantized downloads under a paid redistrib license. Thoughts on whether we can support a dual SKU (hosted + SI-download) without opening Pandora's box?
Mike L.: Dual SKU makes sense commercially but opswise we need strict separation: different tenancy, separate billing, and different telemetry retention. Also need KMS boundaries for downloads.
Jessie (Partnerships): Agreed. From partner success POV, SIs expect a single bundle they can ship with on-prem HW. We should map the download SKU to an "SI Bundle" that includes signing/manifest, provenance token, and a lightweight install shim.
Rohit (Legal): Important flags: 1) NovaModels' draft license permits redistribution to end-customers but requires attribution and prohibits resale as a competing hosting service. Need to review clause on sublicensing to SIs — we may require an addendum for clarity. 2) Export controls: some weights have restricted export countries; we need geoblock enforcement in the download flow.
Ana P.: Good catch on geoblock. Ops: can we enforce geo gating on the download artifact URLs and at the marketplace SKU level? onboard-bot: "Artifact policy created: nova-13b-v1.tar.gz ; geo-restrictions=EU,US,CA; signature=enabled" :robot_face:
Mike L.: Yes — CDN signed URLs + ACL at auth layer. We'll also require the SI to present a signed provisioning request (cert) before download. That cert ties to a contract ID.
Jessie (Partnerships): Marketing/announce stuff: Nova prefers a simultaneous marketplace listing with a joint blog. Elena, can you stage a co-announcement calendar with embargo + SI partner references?
Elena (Marketing): I can put a draft calendar together. Need approved logo usage and attribution language from Nova. Also request: one partner case study slot for an SI integration demo (30s video).
Rohit (Legal): Logo and attribution: Nova provided a short branding kit and the attribution sentence. I'll incorporate into the addendum and the marketplace listing copy. Also drafting a simple redistribution addendum that SIs sign when they request the download SKU.
Ana P.: Operational checklist to ship this: 1) Legal adds redistribution addendum + geoblock terms 2) Ops creates SI Bundle SKU and deployment manifest 3) Partnerships + Nova align on logos/announce 4) Marketing prepares embargoed assets 5) SRE adds telemetry/incident hooks for SI downloads. Owner assignments?
Mike L.: Ops will own 2 & 5. ETA: 2 weeks for SKU plumbing, 3 weeks for telemetry.
Rohit (Legal): I'll circulate addendum draft by EOD tomorrow.
Jessie (Partnerships): I'll coordinate with Nova on logo/legal approvals and start SI interest list.
Elena (Marketing): I'll draft the calendar and a lightweight partner demo ask template by Thursday.
Ana P.: Excellent. One more nuance: Nova asked for a revenue share split for download licensing when SIs resell. We haven't agreed rates — Partnerships + Finance need to model. Jessie, can you capture expected ARR uplift scenarios?
Jessie (Partnerships): On it. I'll send a short spreadsheet with conservative / base / upside scenarios and pricing tiers for SI bundles.
onboard-bot: "Action created: track-3001234567 - redistribution-addendum (owner=Rohit)" :white_check_mark:
